hook: If you flew to Jupiter, you'd find a moon bigger than Mercury.
title: Jupiter's Moon Is Bigger Than Mercury
description:
Ganymede, a moon of Jupiter, is wider than the planet Mercury and is the largest moon in the Solar System. Mercury is still the heavier of the two. Part of the series If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #IfYouWereInSpace
